featured.reason: Design skill for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more): one skill with 24 commands (init, audit, critique, polish, adapt, animate, live...), PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md project context, and 62 deterministic detector rules that run without an LLM via CLI, hook or browser extension. Installer adds edit hooks and downloads an engine binary on first run, so review before installing.
ideas: Run `/impeccable init` and `/impeccable document` in ai-daily-radar so PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md record the original design you approved, giving every agent that edits the site a written spec to stay on.

Run `npx impeccable detect` (62 deterministic rules, no LLM or API key) over the site's HTML/CSS to find generic AI tells like nested cards, gray-on-color text or Inter everywhere, and fix only what it flags.
Use `/impeccable adapt` and `/impeccable audit` on the mobile layout to check responsive, accessibility and performance issues that show up in the Android app's WebView.
Try `/impeccable live` or `/impeccable generate` to iterate variants of one element, such as a repo card or the hero, in the browser before you commit a change.
Run `/impeccable critique` then `/impeccable polish` on one of your client portfolio pages to tighten hierarchy and copy before showing it in job applications.

featured.reason: Together AI's anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode: 48 themes, page built from its job, sloplint checks at eight widths plus a fresh-context reviewer, and report-only /hallmark audit or content-preserving /hallmark redesign. Browser checks need puppeteer-core and Chrome; produces self-contained HTML/CSS.
ideas: Run `/hallmark audit ./index.html` (report-only) on your portfolio pages to list machine-made tells, like eyebrows above every heading or one colored headline word, without changing anything.
Run `node skills/hallmark/scripts/sloplint.mjs <dir> --render` to check a page at eight widths and catch broken phone layouts before release (needs puppeteer-core and Chrome).

Build a sample landing page for an industry you've worked in, such as the Furrow theme for an agriculture client or Dose for a health app, and compare it to what your agent produces without the skill.
Use `/hallmark redesign <path>` with "polish" on an old client page; `sloplint --before` and `--kept` fail the run if any link, form field or handler went missing.
Study its tiered gates (Floor, Reflex, Finish) and the fresh-context reviewer, and try `install-hook.mjs` to add an edit-time Floor check to Claude Code for your own front-end work.
